title: Kuznetsov Rationality Conjecture for Cubic Fourfolds
exact_target: Is a smooth cubic fourfold rational exactly when its Kuznetsov component is the ordinary derived category of a projective K3 surface?

sources.citation: Alexander Kuznetsov, Derived Categories of Cubic Fourfolds, arXiv0808.3351v1,25August2008,18pages.
